source_detail: Built in ca-tools 2026-11-08 (debate 14): the 16 columns are indexed by the vectors of GF(2)^4 and the group Z_2^4 acts on them by XOR on the index; the array is the 16 images of each of 6 generator words (96 rows, no constant rows), found by annealing on one representative of each group orbit of 5-sets (programs/grpq.c, command grpq 5 16 6 0 xor 3 90 2.0 b96_xor -r 30, random start, 0 holes in under 90 s; generators in programs/starts/b96_xor_gen.txt); exact check with ca_verify, all 5-sets
construction: Group-orbit array: the Z_2^4 (XOR) images of 6 generator words on 16 columns, found by orbit-class annealing
notes: beats the Torres-Jimenez size 98 at k = 16 by 2 rows; the cyclic group Z_16 stops 3 orbit classes short at this size, the elementary abelian group closes it; no Torres-Jimenez array is an ingredient or start; random start
